purpose: Machine-readable investor-facing economic dashboard for a distributed compute infrastructure supporting UFCPS swarm processes.

capital_requirement.notes: Capital values must be derived from an actual deployment plan, verified quotations, capacity targets, and operating assumptions.

deployment_model.description: Verified compute capacity may be supplied by graphics processors connected to ordinary participant computers rather than by dedicated centralized data-center hardware.
deployment_model.resource_provider_role: provide verified process continuity by making computing capacity available; resource providers are not required to solve the research question.

participant_gpu_pool.sponsorship_note: A participant may voluntarily provide GPU capacity as an in-kind mission contribution without financial return; this is distinct from paid compute provision.

derived_outputs.operating_costs: energy + maintenance + depreciation + network + transaction + other

risk_register.description: Insufficient demand for verified compute capacity.
Energy cost increases reduce operating margin.
Hardware depreciation, failure, or obsolescence reduces effective capacity.
Currency volatility affects cross-border compute procurement and settlement.
Weak verification can create disputes over delivered compute.
Network or settlement costs may become material at scale.
Applicable legal, tax, financial, or data rules may constrain operating design.
The underlying swarm-intelligence hypothesis may remain experimentally unresolved.

assumptions_and_uncertainties: Compute-unit normalization requires benchmark calibration and verification.
Market pricing for verified compute is not fixed by this model.
Capital requirements are deployment-specific and must be populated from evidence.
Scenario multipliers are analytical placeholders, not forecasts.
The economic model does not establish that distributed resources will produce AGI or swarm intelligence.
Legal, tax, payment, and regulatory treatment requires jurisdiction-specific review.
Sponsorship levels and contribution thresholds are placeholders until payment, compliance, and community-policy requirements are defined.

A significant portion of capacity may come from participant-owned GPUs connected through ordinary computers; availability, verification, heterogeneity, network quality, and device failure must therefore be modeled explicitly.
Non-financial sponsor benefits are intended to provide tangible participation value; exact thresholds, delivery channels, and recognition rules require pilot validation and compliance review.

provenance.last_update_reason: Added distributed participant-owned GPU contribution as a non-centralized compute-capacity source and in-kind mission participation mode.

sponsorship.mission: Support the development of distributed swarm intelligence and research into AGI as a possible evolutionary step in the development of intelligence.

empathy_and_altruism.framing: Participation is offered as an act of empathy, solidarity, and altruistic support for a shared long-term research objective.

sponsorship.bonus_principle: Every sponsor should receive a tangible non-financial benefit that recognizes participation and gives useful access to project information without representing a financial return.

bonus_program.eligibility: any qualifying sponsorship or in-kind contribution
bonus: public acknowledgement when the participant opts in

bonus_program.eligibility: higher recurring sponsorship or sustained resource contribution
bonus: early access to selected research updates
invitations to selected online project briefings

bonus_program.eligibility: substantial recurring sponsorship or significant sustained resource contribution
bonus: early access to selected public reports or demos

news_bonus.name: Swarm News
news_bonus.description: A dedicated project news stream covering research progress, experiments, infrastructure growth, unresolved questions, negative results, milestones, and upcoming activity.
news_bonus.commercial_value_statement: Informational and recognition benefit only; no guaranteed monetary value.

rules: Benefits are non-transferable unless explicitly stated.
Benefits do not constitute dividends, interest, equity, profit share, or investment return.
Access to research updates does not guarantee positive results.
Participants may choose whether and how their contribution is publicly acknowledged.
Bonus thresholds should be calibrated after pilot testing and compliance review.

swarm_points.purpose: Накопление бонусных очков за вклад участника в вычислительный рой.
swarm_points.principle: Очки являются бонусным механизмом лояльности и не являются денежными средствами, долей собственности или гарантированной финансовой доходностью.

earn_sources.points_method: Начисление по фактически проверенному объёму предоставленного вычислительного ресурса.

earn_sources.description: Предоставление вычислительных или иных ресурсов без денежной оплаты.
earn_sources.points_method: Начисление по заранее опубликованным правилам вклада.

earn_sources.description: Подтверждённый вклад в эксперименты, тестирование и верификацию.
Полезный вклад в экосистему: документация, баг-репорты, воспроизводимость и другие подтверждённые действия.

participant_feedback_loop.description: Чем больше участник способствует непрерывности вычислительного процесса, тем больше доступных бонусов он получает для собственного использования вычислительных возможностей роя.
